negative_results: The clean split-before-fit pipeline (clean_pipeline) passes all five detectors: train and test folds are disjoint, the split precedes every fitting step, preprocessing and selection are fit on the train fold only, no predictor is a label proxy, and every training item precedes every test item in time.

A clean, non-circular audit is NOT refused as confirmatory: refuse_circular_result_as_confirmatory passes silently on it. The audit is a necessary, not sufficient, condition for evidence: a clean audit does not assert the result is true, replicated, or physically measured.
A single planted leak fires exactly one detector, not the others (test_only_the_planted_kind_fires): the detectors are independent and do not cross-trip.
A circular result is refused as confirmatory for every one of the five leak kinds (refuse_circular_result_as_confirmatory raises): a result that already contains its own inputs measures nothing new.
A MODEL_PREDICTION is never a physical measurement (refuse_model_as_measurement) and there is no PHRYLL_DETECTED state (refuse_phryll_detected); both raise.
No physical measurement was performed; measured_here is nothing and PHYSICAL_VALIDATION_NOT_CLAIMED. The audit operates no apparatus and types only the pipeline it is given.
reopening_test: Reopen the circularity audit if any pipeline step changes fold, selection fold, label-derivation, or timestamp ordering: re-run every detector. A pipeline flagged circular is reopened to CLEAN only when the offending step is re-run on a strictly disjoint, split-before-fit, label-blind, time-ordered fold, and no result from a circular pipeline may be offered as confirmatory until then. Reopen the whole lane if any detector ever passes a pipeline with a planted leak of its kind, if the clean split-before-fit pipeline is ever flagged circular, or if a circular result is ever emitted at a class above MODEL_PREDICTION or offered as confirmatory.

claims.statement: A circularity and leakage audit: five detectors (train/test leakage, double-dipping, target leakage, preprocessing-before-split, temporal leakage) each returning whether an analysis pipeline is circular by that mechanism; audit_pipeline() runs them all over a list of typed PipelineStep records and flags the circular steps with a deterministic content hash; and refuse_circular_result_as_confirmatory() refuses to offer a circular result as confirmation of a hypothesis. A planted leak of each kind is caught; a clean split-before-fit pipeline passes.
